title: Terrible user experience - Unusable on IOS
body:
This app performs incredibly poorly. The overall system is highly unstable, laggy, and constantly freezes. I encounter severe touch-
responsiveness issues every time I try to select an option. It is so poorly programmed that even trying to type out this review within the App Store overlay feels like a miracle because the app's background performance is dragging the whole system down. I expected much better optimization on iOS, but it has been a terrible experience. Avoid until they fix these massive performance issues.

title: Lock Past Days and Mark Missed Habits
body:
Really love this app! It’s minimal, clean, and includes everything you actually need.

One small suggestion: add a cross/red mark for habits that were missed on a particular day. Ideally, once a day has passed, that day should be locked and no longer editable. Currently, you can go back and mark any previous day, which can make streaks less meaningful.

It would be great to have an option to restrict editing past days so the habit history stays accurate and authentic.

title: Works Really Well!
body: I think it would also be really nice to have the option to add a note or specific value to a habit for each day.
